create_logger_instance: create a Logger instance that writes output to both stdout and a specified log file path
write_log_message: write a message to both the terminal and the log file using the Logger write method
init_logger_append_mode: initialize a Logger in append mode to add to an existing log file without overwriting
init_logger_write_mode: initialize a Logger in write mode to create or overwrite a log file at the given path
review_logger_class: review the Logger class that duplicates stdout to a file with automatic directory creation
